name: Muzeum Sztuki Nowoczesnej w Warszawie (MSN)
known: Joanna Mytkowska has been director since 6 June 2007 (Wikipedia).

name: Ujazdowski Castle CCA
known: Directors: Fabio Cavallucci from 2010 to 2016 (Wikipedia).
CIMAM calls it a public cultural institution and states that the Minister of Culture and National Heritage appointed Bernatowicz as its director (CIMAM, 27 November 2019).
In November 2024 Minister Hanna Wróblewska announced a competition for the Centre's director (dzieje.pl, 19 November 2024).
2020-24 directorship was politically contested, not a funding issue.

name: BWA Wrocław
known: Maciej Bujko took over on 17 September 2020 after a competition decided by a nine-member committee chaired by Jerzy Pietraszek, director of the city's Culture Department (City of Wrocław, 8 September 2020).

name: Muzeum Sztuki in Łódź (ms1 & ms2)
known: Director: Daniel Muzyczuk, appointed by the Ministry of Culture and National Heritage after a selection committee recommended him unanimously.
He had been acting director since July 2024 (ArtReview, 11 August 2025).

name: Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation
known: The Calouste Gulbenkian Museum closed for more than a year of works on a renovation designed by Teresa Nunes da Ponta and reopened on 18 July 2026 under director Xavier F.

name: Culturgest
known: Caixa Geral de Depósitos, S.A. (founder)

name: Galeria Zé dos Bois (ZDB)
known: Created in 1994 as a non-profit by a civic initiative of fifteen founders, who wanted an alternative structure to the institutional and commercial panorama (stated by ZDB).
Natxo Checa is one of the founders and the current director (Observador, Agência Lusa, 29 November 2024).

name: Hangar – Centro de Investigação Artística
known: FIELD describes Mónica de Miranda as a founder and Bruno Leitão as Hangar's curatorial director and a board member.
The e-flux directory describes it as an independent space managed by artists and curators, with projects focused on Lisbon.

name: MAC/CCB Museu de Arte Contemporânea do Centro Cultural de Belém
Serralves Foundation
known: Founders: Wikipedia counts 181 founders.

The Foundation's page of "Patron Founders", Founders who contributed to the Annual Fund, lists names for 2021 to 2024 with no amounts, among them Galp Energia (all four years) and Tabaqueira (2021 and 2022).
The Portuguese State is a founder since 1989.
Serralves posts yearly reports with audited accounts from 1989 to 2020 and names founders.

name: Serralves Museum of Contemporary Art
known: Wikipedia says there are currently 181 founders, including companies, individuals and institutions.
Serralves says the Founders' sponsorship and the state subsidy keep the foundation's finances in balance (Serralves, Maecenas and Sponsors page).

The 2024 Patron Founders list names 59 contributors to the Annual Fund, including Amorim Investimentos e Participações, Bankinter, Bial, Brisa, Caixa Geral de Depósitos, CTT, El Corte Inglés, Fidelidade, GALP Energia, Inditex, Mota-Engil, REN, Sonae and Vodafone Portugal, and the municipalities of A
